## IUpdateQueueConfig type

Update queue configuration for backpressure and worker pooling.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IUpdateQueueConfig = {
    enabled?: boolean;
    maxQueueSize?: number;
    workerCount?: number;
    perChatConcurrency?: number;
    blockWhenFull?: boolean;
    enqueueTimeoutMs?: number;
    waiterTimeoutMs?: number;
    drainTimeoutMs?: number;
};
```

## Remarks

Enable this for polling and webhook deployments. The queue buffers incoming updates and dispatches them to a worker pool, decoupling source latency from handler work. Both modes configure the same [UpdateQueue](./gramstax.updatequeue.md) class; each keeps its own instance, so the two never contend with one another.

## Example 1


```typescript
webhookQueue: {
  enabled: true,
  maxQueueSize: 5000,
  workerCount: 8,
  perChatConcurrency: 1,
  blockWhenFull: true
}
```

## Example 2


```typescript
optionsDeploy: {polling: {queue: {enabled: true, workerCount: 8}}}
```
